description: This file is an abstract test case class for PHPUnit tests within the OrangeHRM project. It provides utility methods for reflection, invoking private and protected methods, and interfacing with the entity manager, specifically for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for PHPUnit test cases, providing utility methods for reflection and method invocation, tailored for the OrangeHRM testing environment.

methods.name: getEntityReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to an entity object by its name and ID, using the entity manager.

methods.name: getClassMethod
methods.description: Reflectively retrieves a method from a given class and makes it accessible.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethod
methods.description: Invokes a private method on a class instance, creating the instance with optional constructor parameters.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a private method on a mock object.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethod
methods.description: Invokes a protected method, similar to invoking a private method.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a protected method on a mock object.
